title: X Tweet Scraper
description: Scrape recent public tweets from authors or hydrate tweets by ID using HTTP only.

searchTerms.title: Search terms (unsupported)
searchTerms.description: Reserved bonus input. Runs reject this field because public search requires authentication.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtags the tweet must contain, with or without #. Applied as an AND post-filter.

since.title: Since
since.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 date or timestamp. A date-only value starts at 00:00:00 UTC.

until.title: Until
until.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 date or timestamp. A date-only value includes the entire UTC day.

language.title: Language
language.description: Tweet language code, for example en.

minLikes.title: Minimum likes
minLikes.description: Minimum like count. Unspecified means no floor.

minRetweets.title: Minimum retweets
minRetweets.description: Minimum retweet count. Unspecified means no floor.

minReplies.title: Minimum replies
minReplies.description: Minimum reply count. Unspecified means no floor.

onlyVerified.title: Only verified authors
onlyVerified.description: If true, keep only tweets from verified authors.

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: Keep tweets that match this media constraint.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: If false, drop reply tweets. Defaults to false.

includeRetweets.title: Include retweets
includeRetweets.description: If false, drop retweets. Defaults to false.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: latest follows timeline order; top ranks each fetched page by engagement.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Requested result cap. Free-tier runs still emit at most 10 items.
